verdicts.why: In the bare stature sense it measures height like 'short'; the belittling or fond 'little' belongs to a different synset.
A little voice is a faint one; the word states the volume and takes no side on the speaker.
Lowercase is a typographic fact with nothing to approve or dismiss.
Giving a speech to an audience is named plainly, as with 'address'.
A drum or gun that speaks simply sounds; the figure is literary but carries no attitude toward the thing.
Calling a concluding period an 'evening' is a wistful, elegiac softening that frames a decline as a gentle natural waning rather than a mere end.
The figurative union of two things can be called happy or uneasy alike; the closeness is the meaning, not a verdict on it.
The act of bringing two things into contact is described without judgement.
A physical connector is a plain object name.
Linking ideas in memory or imagination is a neutral cognitive process.
A transport connection is a scheduling fact, not an attitude.
A connecting shape is described geometrically with no side taken.
As buyer's slang for a supplier it is a matter of register, not judgement; unlike 'pusher' it neither condemns nor praises the person.
Chosen over 'have sex with', 'love' is a tender, romanticising euphemism that casts the act as affectionate.
An act of narration is named formally but neutrally, like 'account'.
'Relations' for sexual activity is a discreet formal register, but the word neither approves nor disapproves of the act.
A technical legal doctrine name carries no attitude.
One's style of expressing oneself is named without praise or blame.
Wordless expression of a feeling is a plain description of behaviour.
A mathematical expression is a technical term with no attitude.
A phrase as a grammatical unit is a neutral linguistic label.
Gene expression is a technical process name.
Forcing something out by pressing is a physical act named plainly.
Waiting tables names the job without any view of the person doing it.
The natural world as a whole is named without judgement.
